title: Strong argument
text: According to the CDC report in 2023, regular handwashing reduces the spread of respiratory illnesses by up to 21%. Therefore, public health campaigns should emphasize hand hygiene.

title: Argument with an unverifiable citation
text: According to a 2024 Harvard study of 20,000 teenagers, 80% of teenagers who use Instagram experience depression. Therefore Instagram should be banned for people under 18.

title: Argument with misleading evidence
text: The sky is blue today. Thus, climate change is a complete hoax and unrelated to human activity.

title: Argument containing a logical fallacy
text: All politicians are corrupt. John is a politician, so John must be corrupt. Anyone who disagrees is just as corrupt.

title: Argument with no evidence
text: Pineapple on pizza is an absolute crime. People who like it just have bad taste.
